title: Organoid Intelligence: At the Boundary of Life and Computation
description: As you may start to understand, at Bloom Lab we are fascinated by ideas that sit right on the edges, where biology intersects with computation, where engineering meets philosophy and where technologies reveal new questions!

title: What we mean when we say “life is biology”
description: As we embark on Bloom Lab and slowly shape our vision, I want to share the idea that drives us, our guiding statement.

title: What is Bloom Lab?
description: When people ask what we do at Bloom Lab, we usually start with a confession: we don’t always know… And that’s kind of the point!
